text_block_list.text:
After our outing, while walking through 
town with Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That ramen shop over there has a 
crazy long line!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It must be super delicious! Let's get in 
line too! The voice of destiny is telling 
us to do it!

This ramen shop is often featured on TV 
and social media, and the taste is 
undeniably good, but—

text_block_list.name: Quiet Customer
text_block_list.text:
Water check, soup spoon check, paper apron 
check. Seated.

text_block_list.name: Headband-wearing Customer
text_block_list.text:
Veggies, extra fat, flavor strong, with 
extra extra garlic.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...The atmosphere is all tense, like the 
underground tunnel before a race.

Indeed, this shop is famous not only for 
its flavor, but also for its notoriously 
strict, unspoken rules against disturbing 
order.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
They've even got a toppings menu! Milk, 
curry powder, yuzu pepper, and whole 
narutomaki... Huh, looks interesting!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
...To the customer with the Triple Crown 
noodle portion, would you like garlic with 
that?
choice_data_list:
(Here they come...! Gotta get the order 
right without messing up...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Extra extra veggies, extra fat, extra 
extra garlic! And throw in all the 
toppings!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Customer
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown... Do you have any idea 
how huge of a portion that is...?

text_block_list.name: Headband-wearing Customer
text_block_list.text:
Mixing all the toppings together like 
that... isn't that considered heresy? 
Where's the respect for the craft...?
choice_data_list: W-Wait, are you really sure about that!?
W-Wait, are you really sure about that!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I decided I wanted to eat it! And the 
voice of destiny says it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Here you go, thanks for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look at that, it's piled so high! 
All right, let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... SO GOOOOD! The noodles 
are so chewy, the meat is fall-apart 
tender, and the whole naruto goes so well 
with the curry powder!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Customer
text_block_list.text:
No talking is the unwritten rule here, 
right...? What a daredevil...!
choice_data_list: Y-You need to eat a little more quietly...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No! This is my way of showing gratitude to 
the shopkeeper!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If it's delicious, you gotta let them 
know! Even the voice of destiny is telling 
me to share the joy!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: This is super delicious, Chef!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah! I ate so much! Thank you for the 
feast!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey there, customer. Why did you order 
that?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Extra extra veggies, extra fat, extra 
extra garlic. Are you talking about the 
Triple Crown with all toppings included?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at the menu on the wall gave me a 
flash of inspiration!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
They're promoting it so prominently! That 
means the shop owner really wants people 
to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And then, the voice of destiny gave me a 
push too! It really was so delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I see. To think you'd actually chant 
that call for me...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, it's something my mom used to 
whip up with whatever was left in the 
fridge when I was a kid."

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
“Still, people treat it like some unspoken 
rule that it's heresy to pair those 
together.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, it'll definitely become a trend! The 
voice of destiny gave me a boost, saying 
this is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny, huh. All right. I'll 
choose to believe in it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks for the food, I'll be back!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Customer
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah— Those toppings were your actual 
recommendation...?

text_block_list.name: Headband-wearing Customer
text_block_list.text:
Next time I come, maybe I'll try ordering 
that...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's been ages since I ate that 
much! What a great experience!"

Whether it was coincidence or fate, I 
cannot say. Yet she undeniably managed to 
find what the manager was looking for.

There's never a dull moment when we're 
together

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hey, I had a lot of fun today too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Trainer slurping ramen so 
contentedly... That's not something you 
get to see every day!
choice_data_list:
When you put it that way again, I feel 
kind of shy...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why are you getting shy! Show me again, 
come on!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I don't know!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! But it's true! I'm not a psychic!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So tell me about yourself! Because I want 
to get to know you more and more!
